name: Mt. San Jacinto College Dual and Concurrent Enrollment
city: San Jacinto, Menifee Valley, San Gorgonio Pass and Temecula Valley campuses, CA
what_you_do: Take college classes while you are in high school. Dual classes meet at your school during the day. Concurrent classes are online, at night or on weekends, with limited seats.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 9 to 12 and in high school now. Your school or district must say yes. 9th and 10th graders cannot take English.
pay_detail: Part-time high school students generally do not pay the $46 per unit fee. Other fees still apply, such as the RTA Go Pass. Dual classes give you the materials. Concurrent students get their own.
duration: By semester. Up to 3 classes and 11 units in fall or spring. Up to 2 classes and 8 units in summer.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 class requests opened Oct 13, 2026 and close Nov 13, 2026. Spring classes start Jan 19, 2027.
how_to_apply: Meet with your counselor. Apply on CCCApply and press Submit at the end. Turn on your MyMSJC account and do the online orientation. Then send a class request in DualEnroll. Register and pay fees in Self-Service.
notes: You must send a new request each semester. An Accepted request does not enroll you, so you still must register. Concurrent credit may not count toward high school graduation. Questions: K12studentinfo@msjc.edu.
